component.name: TMail
component.summary: Unofficial, keyboard-first client for Tuta Mail

description.p: TMail is an independent desktop client for Tuta Mail. It keeps Tuta's end-to-end encryption intact while treating the mailbox as a local, encrypted database: instant list scrolling, full-text search and offline reading of messages you have already opened.

The interface is built for the keyboard: j and k to move, Enter to open, c to compose, Ctrl+K for every action. HTML mail is rendered in a sandboxed frame, and remote images and tracking pixels are blocked until you allow them per sender.
TMail is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Tutao GmbH. "Tuta" is used only to describe the service it connects to.
First development snapshot: sign-in, folders, message list, reader, composer, local search, encrypted cache and realtime events.
